title.en: Carriage of Goods by Sea (Singapore Currency Equivalents) Order

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Order may be cited as the Carriage of Goods by Sea (Singapore Currency Equivalents) Order.

heading.en: Sums equivalent to those stated in Rules

text.en: 2. For the purposes of paragraph 5 of Article IV of the Rules and of Article IV bis of the Rules set out in the Schedule to the Act, $1,563.65 cents and $4.69 cents are hereby specified as the amounts which shall be taken as equivalent to 10,000 gold francs and 30 gold francs, respectively.
